description: This 2023 Lamborghini Urus Performante is the most focused, track-capable version of Lamborghini's Super SUV, and this car takes that character even further. It wears a satin bronze wrap and a full 1016 Industries widebody kit. The kit adds carbon fiber fender flares, a reshaped front bumper with carbon fiber splitter elements, a vented hood, carbon fiber side skirts, a roof-mounted rear spoiler and an aggressive carbon fiber rear diffuser. Black multi-spoke wheels with Lamborghini center caps complete a look that is wider, lower and far more dramatic than any standard Urus.Power comes from Lamborghini's 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, tuned in Performante form to produce 657 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque. It is paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time all-wheel drive with an electro-mechanical limited-slip differential. The Urus Performante accelerates from 0 to 62 mph in 3.3 seconds and reaches a top speed of 190 mph. Lamborghini also made the Performante lighter than the standard Urus. In place of the standard car's air suspension, it uses a sport-tuned chassis with coil springs, adaptive magnetic dampers and active anti-roll bars, giving it a sharper, more connected feel on the road and on track.The interior matches the exterior's intensity. It is trimmed in black Alcantara and leather with yellow contrast stitching throughout. The seats feature hexagonal quilting, embroidered URUS lettering, Lamborghini shield headrests and Performante script on the bolsters. Bright yellow seatbelts, an Alcantara headliner with hexagonal stitching, carbon fiber dashboard and console trim, and an Alcantara steering wheel with a red top-center marker give the interior a purpose-built motorsport atmosphere.Few vehicles combine everyday usability with this level of performance and visual impact. With seating for five, a usable cargo area and all-weather all-wheel drive, this Urus Performante works as a daily driver. description: 2020 MAZDA CX-5 GRAND TOURING RESERVE AWD  2.5L SKYACTIV-G TURBO 4-CYLINDER | 6-SPEED AUTOMATIC | i-ACTIV AWD | 5-PASSENGER SUV  This 2020 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring Reserve AWD combines compact-SUV practicality with a genuinely stronger turbocharged powertrain, standard all-wheel drive and a higher level of comfort than the mainstream CX-5 trims. VIN JM3KFBEY8L0754664 corresponds to the Grand Touring Reserve configuration with Mazdas 2.5L turbocharged engine and i-ACTIV AWD. Mazda confirms the Grand Touring Reserve received the turbo engine and AWD as standard equipment for 2020.  WHY THIS CX-5 STANDS OUT  The Grand Touring Reserve is an important distinction because this is not the standard 187-horsepower CX-5 powertrain. Its SKYACTIV-G 2.5T turbo engine produces 227 horsepower and 310 lb-ft of torque on regular 87-octane fuel, or up to 250 horsepower and 320 lb-ft when using 93-octane premium. Mazda pairs it with a conventional 6-speed automatic and standard i-ACTIV AWD with Off-road Traction Assist.  THE 30-SECOND EXPERT SUMMARY  This CX-5 makes sense for someone who wants the manageable dimensions of a compact SUV but does not want compact-SUV performance to feel like a compromise. The turbocharged engine provides substantially more torque than the standard CX-5 engine, while AWD adds useful traction for changing Colorado weather. The Grand Touring Reserve also moves the CX-5 toward a more premium ownership experience without requiring a larger SUV.  WHAT YOU'LL NOTICE EVERY DAY  This trim was equipped with features that matter in regular use, including leather-trimmed seating, ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, a heated steering wheel, a windshield-projected Active Driving Display and Bose premium audio. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto were also standard.  The CX-5 provides approximately 30.9 cubic feet of cargo space behind the rear seats and up to 59.6 cubic feet with additional cargo space opened up. That gives you useful SUV versatility without moving into a substantially larger vehicle.  THIS CX-5 MAKES THE MOST SENSE IF...  This Mazda is a strong fit if you want AWD traction, prefer a smaller and easier-to-maneuver SUV, appreciate stronger turbocharged performance and want premium comfort features without stepping into a larger three-row vehicle.  CONSIDER ANOTHER VEHICLE IF...  This may not be the right choice if you regularly need three-row seating, maximum cargo capacity or heavy-duty towing capability. If five-passenger versatility, AWD confidence and stronger-than-typical compact-SUV performance are higher priorities, the Grand Touring Reserve configuration makes a compelling case.  CONDITION YOU CAN SEE BEFORE YOU VISIT  A pre-owned vehicle should be represented by what can actually be verified.
